utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still in for the repair drive today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what time are we meeting up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I might need a reminder later, but I’ll swing by when I’m ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — just drop by when you’re ready, and I’ll have the tools handy for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a nice little turnout. If you want, I can pass along what I know about when they’re collecting things.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — that’d help. I’m just trying to figure out the timing so I can get things together without missing the collection.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I heard they’re collecting this Saturday morning, and probably wrapping up by noon. If you’re bringing something, it’d be safest to drop it off earlier rather than later.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you head to the community center and check in with the repair drive table? Then let me know what supplies they still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll head over now and check in with the table, then I’ll report back on what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling folks now—want me to put your name down and swing by with the details?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Put my name down and bring the details by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put you on the list and drop by with the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving. I’ve got the sign-up list ready—want to help me sort the first round of tasks?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — send me the list and I’ll help sort the first round.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send it over now, and we can split the tasks by urgency and skill.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what details you have for the repair drive? I want to make sure I get everything right before I act.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I don’t have the full details yet, but I can check and send them over before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — that would help a lot. I’ll wait for the details before I do anything else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and do you need anything from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’m still pinning down the exact time, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set. If you can help spread the word once I confirm, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll help spread the word. Happy to work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that’ll make it easier for me to keep track. Just remind me what’s still missing, and I’ll help with the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand, but I can check around and pass along what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm exactly what you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the basics: what item needs fixing, your address, and a quick photo if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive — what still needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think the biggest need is still tools and a few spare parts, but I should double-check the list. I’m sorry, my memory’s a bit patchy today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries — I can help look over the list with you if you want.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and see what they still need. If you’re going, I can head over with you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That sounds good—I can go with you and check what supplies they still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, let’s go together later and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate that a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything helpful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, but I’ll need a reminder on what’s needed again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — the repair drive just needs a few hands for sorting donations and fixing up the bikes. I’ll remind everyone to bring tools and whatever spare parts they have.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I can help sort donations and I’ll bring a few tools if I can find them. Just remind me what time and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I might’ve missed a bit — what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re still collecting tools and spare parts; if you can, swing by the community center this afternoon. I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll try to stop by the community center this afternoon. Thanks for keeping the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate that. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll make a clear list of what’s needed, and we can go from there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — send the list my way and I’ll see what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m still happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara! Could you help spread the word and maybe sign up a couple neighbors? I’ll send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — send me the details, and I’ll start reaching out to a couple neighbors tonight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and make sure the right folks hear about it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Jules—could you tell me where you’ll post the details so I can keep track?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll post it in the neighborhood group, the bulletin board by the cafe, and the community chat. I’ll let you know as soon as it’s up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone updated. Let’s make sure we’ve got the list and timing set for the block.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll check our supplies list and bring what we have. Just send me the timing and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll send the timing once I confirm it, and I’ll keep the list moving too. Thanks, Cleo — your help makes this much easier.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m checking who still needs help and what supplies we’re short on. Do you want the quick rundown or the volunteer list?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Quick rundown, please — I’ve only heard the highlights so far.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help me by checking the school pickup window first? I’m trying to make sure the repair drive doesn’t clash with it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll check the school pickup window first and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re actually free to help with it, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I’m free to help with it.
